visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with dark hair tied in two small pigtails stands in an indoor living space, looking intently at a large white and red cup of noodles positioned on a wooden table. An adult's hand is visible in the foreground, using wooden chopsticks to stir the noodles inside the cup. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting a comfortable home environment. (2) The adult lifts a cluster of brown noodles with the chopsticks, bringing them towards the girl's face. The girl watches with a curious and focused expression, resting one finger near her open mouth. In the background, wooden storage shelves filled with books, toys, and household items are clearly visible. (3) The girl opens her mouth wide in joyful anticipation as the noodles are held up in the air. She appears very excited, shifting her body weight slightly and keeping her eyes fixed on the food. The camera maintains a steady medium close-up shot of her face and the noodle cup. (4) The adult uses a white plastic spoon to carefully feed a small portion of noodles into the girl's mouth. She takes the bite readily and begins chewing with a satisfied expression. The framing focuses on her reactions as she experiences the taste of the meal. (5) The girl begins pointing at the noodle bowl with her hand and makes gestures indicating she wants another bite. The adult is seen preparing more noodles while continuing to interact with her verbally. The girl leans closer to the table, showing persistence in her desire for more food. (6) A final pink graphic screen appears, featuring a stylized cartoon illustration of a young girl with pigtails in the center. The text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" is displayed in white capital letters below the illustration, serving as the closing branding for the video.
